The Toyota production system has been built on the practice and evolution of this scienti c approach. By asking and answering “why” ve times, we can get to the real cause of the problem, which is often hidden behind more obvious symptoms.1 Note that even in Ohno’s relatively simple example the root cause moves away from a technical fault (a blown fuse) and toward a human error (someone forgot to attach a strainer). This is completely typical of most problems that startups face no matter what industry they are in.
